name: ai.clomni.messenger
description: Opens the Clomni Messenger inside a Unity game or app on Android and iOS, through the native Clomni SDKs: users, flows, push and the unread count.

samples.description: Three buttons: open the messenger, log a user in, start a flow.
Hands Firebase Cloud Messaging's token and messages to Clomni. Needs the Firebase Unity SDK.
